source: SAIS T&I mailing list (sais.ti@lists.jh.edu), email of 2026-09-02

events.title: Strat & Tech Open Meeting
events.why: Semester kickoff for all Strategy, Security, Tech and Intelligence programming at SAIS; lunch provided.
events.description: Introductory open meeting covering focus areas, faculty, affiliated centers and student clubs.

events.title: AI & the Future of Warfare
events.host: SAIS SSS focus area and D&I Club
events.why: Panel with RAND, the Joint Staff Chief AI Officer and CDAO, moderated by Mara Karlin; lunch provided.

events.title: Getting Tech Right: U.S.-China Policy for a New Era
events.location: Kenney Link, Hopkins Bloomberg Center, 555 Pennsylvania Ave NW
events.why: Full-day conference on US-China tech relations; Session 2 on China's tech ecosystem with Jonas Nahm, Kevin Xu, Chenjian Li and Kendra Schaefer.

events.title: Information Session: SAIS Emerging Technologies Fellowship
events.why: Q&A with ETI Director Olga Belogolova on the fellowship; applications due September 14 via SMILE.

events.title: The Many Faces of AI Governance: How Cities and States are Shaping Policy Across the US
events.why: T&I panel on state and city AI policy with FAS, CDT, Public Citizen and the State of Maryland, hosted by Melissa Griffith. In person only.

events.title: Who Governs the Machine? Rules, Responsibilities, and the Public Good
events.location: Theater, Hopkins Bloomberg Center, 555 Pennsylvania Ave NW
events.why: Stuart Russell, Dean Ball (OpenAI) and Gillian Hadfield on who sets the rules for AI; free, registration required.

events.title: AAAS Tech & Diplomacy Panel
events.why: How policymakers work with scientists in government, with a SAIS alum and a State Department AAAS fellow; lunch at 1, panel at 1:30.

events.title: Conference: Envisioning the Future of Global Supply Chains
events.why: Geoeconomics and resilience workshop; the afternoon panel on supply chains for AI (WSJ moderator, Wharton, McKinsey, CMU) is the T&I-relevant part.

events.title: The Economic Impact of AI
events.why: Fabio Curto of Google on the macroeconomic shifts driven by AI, hosted by Deb Watuski. In person only.

events.title: Energy Trading Institute Annual Conference: Power Markets at a Crossroads
events.host: JHU Energy Trading Institute and ROSEI
events.why: Data centers, market design and the new grid; free for Hopkins affiliates via Eventbrite.

events.title: Authors & Insights: Kevin Roose on the Race for AGI
events.why: New York Times journalist Kevin Roose on his book The AGI Chronicles; register via JHU Hub.

events.title: Disrupting Politics: A Front Row Seat to the Collision of Technology and Democracy
events.why: ETI fireside chat with Katie Harbath, former Facebook executive, on platforms and politics; moderated by Olga Belogolova.

events.title: How Energy Innovation Will Scale AI
events.host: SAIS T&I focus area and Energy and Environment Club
events.why: Hybrid panel on data-center energy demand, grid modernization and power supply chains; lunch provided.

events.title: Careers in Technology and National Security
events.host: SAIS T&I and SSS focus areas
events.why: Semesterly careers roundtable with 13+ guests from the tech and security world; RSVP via Global Careers.

events.title: Accenture Federal Services Early Career Build Challenge
events.why: Full-day hands-on challenge in Palantir Foundry with AFS engineers; SAIS alum Garrett Berntsen kicks off. Register by September 11.
